market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a secure mid-table club with no recent relegations, strong finances, and a quality squad. The market’s 34.5% implied probability is far too high, matching bottom-five clubs, not an established Premier League side. True relegation risk is around 7–10%.
evidence_points: West Ham have avoided relegation since 2010–11 and finished between 6th and 16th in the last ten seasons.
The club retains a strong core of internationals and has consistently invested in the squad.
Historical relegation odds for similar mid-table clubs rarely exceed 10% in any single season.
sources_consulted: Current West Ham squad and transfermarkt valuations
